build_DPTHead_for_depth_estimation: build a DPTHead module for monocular depth estimation using ViT backbone features and multi-scale fusion
create_ReassembleBlocks_for_ViT_features: create ReassembleBlocks to process ViT cls tokens and rearrange feature vectors into multi-scale feature maps
create_FeatureFusionBlock_for_multi_scal: create a FeatureFusionBlock to merge and upsample feature maps from different ViT stages with residual conv units
